name: change-freeze-and-deploy-compliance-reporter
description: Fleet-wide compliance scoring of deploys that violated change-freeze windows or skipped required gates (readiness review, release testing, approvals), across GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, and Azure DevOps. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (a custom CI/change-management MCP) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SUN at 07:00 UTC
